annotations.title: Run an Israeli pay / tax / benefit calculation

description: Run one calculator of the rules API and get outputs, a breakdown and every parameter used (effective date + official sources). Calculators: income-tax (Income tax by bracket (2020-2026)); net-salary (Net salary (gross to net, net to gross), 2026); credit-points (Credit points by profile (tax year 2026)); national-insurance (National Insurance + health contributions (employee, employer, self-employed), 2026); severance (Severance pay and its tax exemption); unemployment (Unemployment benefit: daily amount, max days, total (2026)); maternity (Maternity allowance (2026)); reserve-pay (Reserve duty compensation (2026)); work-injury (Work injury allowance (2026)); recuperation (Recuperation pay (private sector)); vacation-days (Annual leave days); notice-period (Notice period (dismissal or resignation)); vat (VAT add / remove (any date since 1976)); purchase-tax (Purchase tax on a home); car-benefit (Company car taxable benefit (2026)); rental-income-tax (Rental income tax: exemption, 10% or regular route (2026)); depreciation (Depreciation schedule (straight line)); employer-cost (Employer cost of a salary (2026)); withholding (Withholding at source from a supplier payment (2026)); surtax (Surtax (mas yesef), 2026); child-allowance (Child allowance and child savings (National Insurance)); birth-grant (Birth grant (National Insurance)); minimum-wage (Minimum wage check); pension-deposits (Mandatory pension deposits). "inputs" must match the inputs schema whose title is the chosen "calc" (inputs.anyOf in this schema). Estimates under the general rules, not legal or tax advice.

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "income-tax": Income tax by bracket (2020-2026). Example: {"year":2026,"period":"monthly","income":15000,"sex":"m"}

extra_points.description: Credit points beyond the base points (children, degree, ...)

sex.description: m = man (2.25 base points), f = woman (2.75)

anyOf.title: income-tax

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "net-salary": Net salary (gross to net, net to gross), 2026. Example: {"direction":"gross_to_net","amount":15000,"sex":"f","children":[2023,2020],"pension_percent":6}

amount.description: Gross (or the target net) per month, ILS

children.description: Birth years of the children (credit points are added for them)

items.description: Birth year of a child aged 0-18 in the tax year

credit_points.description: Total credit points, if you already know them (overrides sex, children and extra_points)

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

extra_points.description: Credit points beyond the base points and the children (degree, discharge, oleh, reserve...)

parent_role.description: Who gets the "mother" child points: main (the mother / parent receiving the child allowance) or other. Default: main for f, other for m (a couple living together)

pension_percent.description: Employee pension deposit, percent of gross

sex.description: m = man (2.25 base points), f = woman (2.75)

single_parent.description: "Single parent" (other parent deceased or not registered)

anyOf.title: net-salary

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "credit-points": Credit points by profile (tax year 2026). Example: {"sex":"m","children":[2025,2022,2017],"parent_role":"other","reserve_combat_days":95}

items.description: Birth year of a child aged 0-18 in the tax year

monthly_salary.description: Optional gross monthly salary, to cap the value at the tax you actually pay

parent_role.description: main = the mother / the parent receiving the child allowance; other = the other parent

reserve_combat_days.description: Combat reserve days in the previous year

service.description: Discharged soldier: 0 none, 2 full service, 1 short service (12+ months)

single_parent.description: "Single parent" (other parent deceased or not registered)

study_years.description: Years of study for the degree (1-3)

anyOf.title: credit-points

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "national-insurance": National Insurance + health contributions (employee, employer, self-employed), 2026. Example: {"role":"self_employed","income":12000}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

income.description: Monthly gross salary, or the self-employed taxable income

period.description: For self_employed: monthly or annual income

anyOf.title: national-insurance

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "severance": Severance pay and its tax exemption. Example: {"start":"2016-01-01","end":"2026-01-01","last_salary":20000}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

fund_balance.description: Severance component balance in the pension fund

job_history.description: Job percent changes: the percent from the start date is job_percent_at_start, each item a later change

job_percent.description: Job percent (when there is no history)

job_percent_at_start.description: With job_history: job percent from the start date until the first change

last_salary.description: Last monthly gross salary (at the current job percent)

reason.description: dismissal, entitled (resignation that entitles to severance) or resign (regular resignation)

anyOf.title: severance

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "unemployment": Unemployment benefit: daily amount, max days, total (2026). Example: {"wage":6000,"age":30,"dependants":0}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

months_worked_last_18.description: Insured months worked in the last 18

reason.description: fired, justified, quit or halat (unpaid leave by the employer)

wage.description: Monthly gross wage (average of the last 6 months), or the 6-month total

women_57_67_born_1960_plus.description: Woman aged 57-67 born 1960 or later (300 days)

anyOf.title: unemployment

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "maternity": Maternity allowance (2026). Example: {"insured_months_of_14":12,"salary_3_months":36000,"salary_6_months":66000}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

salary_3_months.description: Gross salary in the 3 months before leave (total)

salary_6_months.description: Gross salary in the 6 months before leave (total)

anyOf.title: maternity

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "reserve-pay": Reserve duty compensation (2026). Example: {"type":"employee","periods":[{"income_3_months":36000,"days":10}]}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

income_3_months.description: Gross income in the 3 months before the service (total)

type.description: employee, hourly, self (self-employed) or none (no income, e.g. student)

anyOf.title: reserve-pay

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "work-injury": Work injury allowance (2026). Example: {"type":"employee","income_3_months":30000,"days":7}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

income_3_months.description: Income in the 3 months before the injury (total)

anyOf.title: work-injury

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "recuperation": Recuperation pay (private sector). Example: {"recuperation_year":2026,"seniority_year":10,"scope_mode":"weekly_hours","scope":18}

completed_first_year.description: Completed a full year at the employer (required for payment)

scope.description: Job percent, weekly hours or average monthly hours

seniority_year.description: Year of work at the employer (1 = first year; 20 = 20 and above)

anyOf.title: recuperation

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "vacation-days": Annual leave days. Example: {"seniority_year":8,"week":"five_day_order","days_worked":150}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

days_worked.description: Work days in the year (optional; below the minimum the entitlement is pro rata)

seniority_year.description: Calendar year of work at the employer (14 = 14 and above)

week.description: five_day_order (5-day week, extension order applies), five_day_law (5-day, no order) or six_day

anyOf.title: vacation-days

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "notice-period": Notice period (dismissal or resignation). Example: {"start":"2025-07-01","notice_date":"2026-04-08","pay_type":"monthly"}

unpaid_leave_months.description: Months of unpaid leave to exclude

anyOf.title: notice-period

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "vat": VAT add / remove (any date since 1976). Example: {"mode":"remove","amount":1180}

custom_rate.description: Custom rate in percent (overrides the date)

date.description: Transaction date for the rate (default today) (YYYY-MM-DD)

anyOf.title: vat

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "purchase-tax": Purchase tax on a home. Example: {"price":2400000,"buyer":"single"}

date.description: Purchase date (default today) (YYYY-MM-DD)

oleh_arrived_before_2024_08_15.description: Oleh who arrived before 15.8.2024 (may choose reg. 12)

oleh_only_home.description: For olim: this will be the only home

anyOf.title: purchase-tax

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "car-benefit": Company car taxable benefit (2026). Example: {"list_price":200000,"fuel":"regular","salary":15000}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

extra_points.description: Credit points beyond the base points

pension_percent.description: Employee pension percent of the salary

salary.description: Optional monthly gross salary without the car

sex.description: m = man (2.25 base points), f = woman (2.75)

anyOf.title: car-benefit

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "rental-income-tax": Rental income tax: exemption, 10% or regular route (2026). Example: {"monthly_rent":7000}

annual_expenses.description: Deductible annual expenses on the apartment (regular route)

annual_work_income.description: Other annual taxable income from work or business

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

monthly_rent.description: Total monthly rent from residential apartments (ILS)

rent_paid_monthly.description: Rent the owner pays as a tenant per month

sex.description: m = man (2.25 base points), f = woman (2.75)

sole_apartment_tenant.description: Owns only this apartment and rents another to live in

anyOf.title: rental-income-tax

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "depreciation": Depreciation schedule (straight line). Example: {"asset_type":"pc","cost":6000,"start":"2026-03"}

asset_type.description: Asset type id from parameter tax.depreciation.rates (e.g. pc, furniture, car)

custom_rate.description: Custom annual rate in percent (instead of asset_type)

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

anyOf.title: depreciation

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "employer-cost": Employer cost of a salary (2026). Example: {"amount":10000}

amount.description: Gross salary, or the budget (ILS per month)

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

employee_credit_points.description: Credit points for the employee net estimate (default 2.25 = man, no extra points)

pension_base.description: Wage for pension deposits (0 = the whole gross)

seniority_year.description: Year of seniority for recuperation days

anyOf.title: employer-cost

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "withholding": Withholding at source from a supplier payment (2026). Example: {"amount":11800,"vat_mode":"incl","certificate":"books"}

base.description: total (withhold from the whole payment incl. VAT) or before_vat

certificate.description: rate (certificate with a rate), zero (exemption), books (bookkeeping certificate only) or none

certificate_rate.description: Rate on the certificate, percent (with certificate=rate)

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

payment_type.description: Payment type id from parameter tax.withholding.regulation_rates (e.g. services, rent)

vat_mode.description: incl (amount includes VAT), excl (VAT is added) or none

anyOf.title: withholding

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "surtax": Surtax (mas yesef), 2026. Example: {"work_income":300000,"capital_income":800000}

capital_income.description: Annual taxable income from capital sources

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

work_income.description: Annual taxable income from work / business

anyOf.title: surtax

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "child-allowance": Child allowance and child savings (National Insurance). Example: {"children_under_18":3}

children_under_18.description: Number of children under 18 in the family

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

parent_adds_savings.description: The parent chose to add the optional amount to the child savings (taken from the allowance)

anyOf.title: child-allowance

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "birth-grant": Birth grant (National Insurance). Example: {"previous_children":1,"babies":1}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

previous_children.description: Children the mother had before this birth

anyOf.title: birth-grant

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "minimum-wage": Minimum wage check. Example: {"pay_type":"monthly","wage":6000,"job_percent":100,"age":30}

age.description: Age of the worker (youth rates under 18)

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

job_percent.description: Job percent, for a monthly wage

wage.description: The wage paid: monthly gross, per hour or per day

week.description: Days per week, for a daily wage

anyOf.title: minimum-wage

anyOf.description: Inputs when calc = "pension-deposits": Mandatory pension deposits. Example: {"monthly_wage":12000,"months_employed":12}

date.description: As-of date for the parameters. Default: today in Israel (YYYY-MM-DD)

had_pension_before.description: Had an active pension fund when starting the job

sex.description: m or f (the order applies from age 21 for men, 20 for women)

anyOf.title: pension-deposits

inputs.description: Inputs of the chosen calculator: the anyOf branch whose title equals "calc"

verbose.description: Include every used parameter value and all sources (default: id, effective date and first source only)

name: calculate
title: Run an Israeli pay / tax / benefit calculation
